{{Top|leg}}
'''Headache Bar''' was a seedy [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], located on level 20 of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Tempest (spice)|tempest spice]] was funneled through the bar by the clientele. Known for being poorly lit, something that suited the intoxicated an inebriate patrons well; it was rumored that around the clock, one of the apparently unconscious beings slumped at a table was actually dead.
